statement: Ashlesha's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Mercury; its presiding deity is the Nagas (serpent deities), symbolized by a coiled serpent. It is traditionally associated with penetrating insight and intensity, a hypnotic or entangling quality that can heal or ensnare.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
